_studyNote_root: Component manifest for Site Snapshot. Remove _studyNote_* keys in a real scaffold. 'id' is a stable GUID. Each tool name must match a function in copilot/ai-plugin.json and a Zod schema export in SiteSnapshotCopilotComponentProperties.ts.

tools.name: analyzeSite
tools.description: Analyse a SharePoint site and show a health snapshot (storage, stale docs, external sharing, largest files).

tools.name: exportSnapshot
tools.description: Export the current snapshot detail rows to a CSV file.

tools.name: emailSnapshot
tools.description: Email the current snapshot summary to the user.
